description: Original synthetic retrieval fixture. Gold is document-level with one full-document chunk each. No-answer queries test absence of gold, not a similarity threshold.

documents.text: Visitors may borrow printed books from the library for twenty-one days.
The observatory admits visitors without charge every Friday evening.
Bicycles must be left in the racks beside the eastern entrance.
The museum gift shop sells postcards showing planets and stars.
Library computers are available for sessions lasting one hour.
Cars use the underground parking garage near the western gate.

queries.text: How long can I keep a volume I checked out?
